content: आह्निक {%a.%} (-की|{%f.%}) [अह्नि भवः, अह्ना निर्वृत्तः साध्यः ठञ्] .²1 Daily, diurnal, performed every day or on a day; संग्रामाद्वयपयातव्यमेतत्कर्म ममाह्निकम् <ls>Mb. 6. 109. 27</ls>. आह्निकः स्वाध्यायः daily course of study; ˚आचारः daily observances. .²2 Employed or occurring every day (as a teacher, servant, or fever). .{@-कम्@} .²1 Any religious rite or duty which is to be performed every day at a fixed hour; अत्राह्निकं सुरश्रेष्ठो जपते <ls>Mb.</ls> .²2 Anything to be performed daily, such as taking meals, bathing <ab>&c.</ab>; प्रभाते काल्यमुत्थाय कृत्वाह्निकमरिंदमः <ls>Rām. 7. 82. 5</ls>. कृताह्निकः संवृत्तः <ls>V. 4</ls>; समुद्रे कृताह्निकः <ls>Mv. 5</ls>. .²3 Daily food. .²4 Daily work or occupation, what may be read on one day. .²5 A division of a work (such as that of the Mahābhāṣya). .{@-चन्द्रिका, -दीपिका, -प्रदीप, -मञ्जरी@} <ab>&c.</ab> <ab>N.</ab> of works.
